Self-supervision, pre-training, and foundation models & Tokenization, Ordering & Graph-specific pretext tasks suited to causal and bidirectional scans, transferable serializers and substructure tokenizers, cross-graph comparable encodings, size and length generalization, scaling studies & DG-Mamba~\cite{yuan2025dg}NR, Mamba-GTC~\cite{Meng2026Mamba-GTC}NR, GLADMamba~\cite{fu2025gladmamba}NR, Transfer-Mamba~\cite{cheng2025transfer}NR \\
